description: Maps agents to their recommended skills by category. Primary skills are essential, secondary are supporting, and contextual are conditionally loaded based on project type.
_documentation: REGISTRY 3-LAYER SYSTEM: Agent registry skills are computed from 3 sources: (1) Agent .md frontmatter 'skills:' field (explicit), (2) This matrix file (centralized augmentation via primary/secondary/always/contextual), (3) skill-index.json (tool requirements per skill). The registry generator merges all 3 layers. This is BY DESIGN — the matrix is the augmentation engine. Apparent 'drift' between frontmatter and registry is expected and intentional.

notes: Primary skills are loaded on agent initialization
Secondary skills are loaded on-demand based on task requirements
Contextual skills are triggered by project detection or explicit request
Always skills are mandatory for all tasks regardless of context
